tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per Tender Document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: For Carpentry & Masonry Power Tools other than Hand Tools the Tenderee should submit OEM Authorization with Tender Indent Number obtained from the manufacturer. OEM obtained from Dealer or Distributor will not be considered.

Authorized letter of ISI & ISO certified sewing machine manufacturing company for participation in this tender with tender notification details/Indent Number, issued to supplier along with Dealership Certificate, should be uploaded.

The suppliers average Net worth in last 3 years should be equal to or more than tender amount. The Certificate in prescribed format with Asset and liabilities Statement as applicable issued by CA duly signed with UDIN number should be submitted.

ISI/BIS Certificate of Sewing Machines Manufacturers. In case of Sewing Machine Companies getting Sewing Machines Manufactured from ISI/BIS Sewing Machines Manufacturers, Such Companies should upload Manufacturing Agreement/MOU/ OEM Authorization with ISI/BIS Sewing Machines Manufacturers.

Rs.500/- Indemnity Bond for not enlisted in black list and for not registered any criminal cases by any agencies/Govt. dept. duly notarized and acceptance in form-IV. The Bond should be executed after this tender notification with tenderer & tenderee as parties.
